newsitem.title: USA: Another bout of cold air forecast for central U.S.
newsitem.headline: Another bout of cold air forecast for central U.S.

text.p: Another round of cold weather will hit the northern U.S. Plains and Midwest this week but meteorologists said this winter blast will be tamer than the last.
"We're not looking for anything as cold as those outbreaks last week," said Joel Burgio, meteorologist with Weather Services Corp.
Last week's cold fronts brought heavy snow and bitterly cold temperatures to much of the central United States.
